therapeutic_hypothesis.compound: yttrium Y 90 DOTA anti-CEA monoclonal antibody M5A combined with FOLFOX/FOLFIRI and bevacizumab
therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: targeted radiotherapy via anti-CEA monoclonal antibody delivery of yttrium-90 radiation combined with chemotherapy and anti-angiogenic therapy
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: tumor cell killing via targeted radiation delivery to CEA-expressing colorectal cancer metastases while inhibiting angiogenesis
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with metastatic colorectal cancer with liver metastases

context.duration: up to 24 months for primary endpoint, up to 5 years for overall survival
